factual_claims.claim: AS Tallinna Sadam Group delivered improved profitability in 2025 despite a slight decline in revenue.

candidate_sentences.text: Cargo throughput increased 5.1% to 13.8 million tonnes, driven mainly by a 47% rise in liquid bulk and moderate growth in dry bulk, although ro-ro volumes declined 2%.

candidate_sentences.text: The Group paid EUR 19.2 million in dividends, or EUR 0.073 per share, and proposed the same dividend for 2025.
